breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent did not fix the inconsistency correctly. Instead of correcting T to 1.0 to match the domain [0, 1.0] (as the ground truth does), the agent propagated the error by changing the domain to [0, 1.1] and keeping T=1.1. The ground truth specifies T=1.0 and domain t in [0, 1.0].
